title: 第4章 戒律堂密报
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
林尘搬进寒月阁隔壁院子的当天下午，刘峰正站在戒律堂后堂的一间密室里。

    密室不大，墙上挂着几把旧剑，都是戒律堂历代首座用过的佩剑。

    油灯在桌上跳动着火苗，光线昏暗，把人的影子拉得长长的。

    刘峰低着头，双手垂在身侧，不敢看坐在对面的灰袍老者。

    “你是说，他炼气六层的灵力，能震退你这个筑基后期？”

    陈元的声音很平，听不出喜怒，但越是平静越让刘峰头皮发麻。

    “是。弟子用了七分力，原本想一爪扣住他的肩膀把他按跪在地上，结果拳爪相撞的时候，他的灵力直接把弟子的手震开了。”

    刘峰抬起右手，虎口上还残留着一道淡淡的红痕。

    “弟子的虎口到现在还在发麻。那股灵力的浑厚程度不像炼气六层，甚至比起筑基中期也不逊色。”

    陈元没有说话，手指在桌面上轻轻敲了两下。

    “还有一件事。”

    刘峰抬起头。

    “玉玲珑前几天突破元婴了。但她突破的时间和林尘修为暴涨的时间完全重合。玉玲珑突破元婴之前，林尘还是个炼气三层的废物。玉玲珑一突破，林尘就开始暴涨——从炼气三层到炼气六层，中间只隔了几天。”

    陈元缓缓站起来，走到墙边取下一把旧剑，手指在剑身上来回摩挲。

    “一个废物突然变成天才，一个困了六年的金丹长老一夜突破元婴，两件事撞在一起——确实不像巧合。”

    他转过身看着刘峰。

    “你在后山跟他交手的时候，有没有感觉到什么特殊的气息？”

    刘峰仔细回想了一下。

    “弟子说不清楚。他的灵力很纯，不是丹药堆出来的那种虚浮，是实实在在的凝练。而且他出拳的时候，拳头上一丝灵力波动都没有，但撞上来之后那股力量才炸开。弟子从来没见过这种方式。”

    陈元把旧剑挂回墙上，坐回椅子里，沉默了很长时间。

    油灯的火苗在静默中跳了好几下。

    “上古十大圣体中，有一种叫混沌圣体。”

    他开口了，声音缓慢，像是在自言自语。

    “据说这种体质的人，修炼速度远超常人，但需要某种契机才能激活。激活之前与凡人无异，激活之后一日千里。如果真是混沌圣体，古籍上说，持有者与任何女修双修，都能让对方突破瓶颈、治愈暗伤、修为暴涨。玉玲珑困了六年一夜突破，就是最好的证明。”

    刘峰倒吸了一口凉气。

    “那林尘岂不是一个人形天材地宝？”

    “比天材地宝更稀有。天材地宝只能用一次，混沌圣体能反复使用。谁控制了他，谁就相当于拥有了一件可以无限使用的突破神器。”

    陈元的声音里多了一丝不易察觉的贪婪。

    “那我们直接把林尘抓来不就行了？”

    刘峰说到一半又停住了。

    “但玉玲珑现在是元婴期，她把林尘护得很紧。今天早上我刚听说她向掌门申请把林尘收为正式弟子，还让他搬进了寒月阁隔壁的院子。那地方紧挨着她的住处，有禁制防护，外人根本进不去。”

    “正面冲突当然不行。玉玲珑突破元婴之后，在宗门里的地位已经不比我低。掌门肯定会站在她那边，硬碰硬吃亏的是我们。”

    “那怎么办？”

    “等。混沌圣体的消息瞒不住。”

    陈元的嘴角微微勾起一个弧度。

    “林尘突破这么快，筑基异象早晚要来。到时候全宗都会看到，想瞒也瞒不住。我们要做的，是在别人反应过来之前，先一步把他控制在手里。”

    “怎么控制？”

    “宗门大比。”

    陈元站起来，走到窗边。

    “今年的大比马上就要开始了。按照惯例，戒律堂有权力对大比期间表现异常的弟子进行审查。让林尘参加大比，在擂台上堂堂正正地试探他的底细。如果他在大比上暴露了混沌圣体的特征，戒律堂就可以名正言顺地把他带回来。”

    “如果他表现得没那么突出呢？”

    “不可能。”

    陈元转过身，眼神阴鸷。

    “混沌圣体一旦觉醒，战斗天赋不是普通修士能比的。就算他再怎么隐藏，一旦上了擂台，生死之间，那东西压不住。”

    刘峰点了点头，但还有犹豫。

    “师叔，如果混沌圣体真的这么稀有，为什么林尘之前三年一直是废物？”

    “一种可能是，混沌圣体需要特定条件才能激活。玉玲珑突破元婴的时候，可能无意中触发了他体内的什么东西。另一种可能是——他之前一直在伪装。不过不管哪种可能，他现在就是一块会走路的修炼资源，谁先拿到谁就能领先别人一大步。”

    陈元抬头看着刘峰。

    “你继续盯着他。不要在后山动手，也不要在他的院子里动手。盯着他每天去什么地方、见什么人、修炼多长时间。还有，你的堂弟刘威，让他离林尘远一点。刘威那种货色除了打草惊蛇没有任何用处。”

    “弟子明白。”

    “让他以后都别靠近。这件事关系到戒律堂的未来，不是你堂弟的个人恩怨。如果刘威再去找林尘麻烦，坏了大局，我不会看你的面子。”

    刘峰脸色一白，赶紧低头。
content_en:
On the afternoon when Lin Chen moved into the yard next to Hanyue Pavilion, Liu Feng was standing in a secret room in the back hall of the Discipline Hall.
The secret room is not big, and there are several old swords hanging on the wall. They are the first swords used by the Discipline Hall in its history.
The flames of the oil lamp danced on the table, and the light was dim, making people's shadows long.
Liu Feng lowered his head and hung his hands by his side, not daring to look at the old man in gray robe sitting opposite.
"You mean, his spiritual power at the sixth level of Qi refining can defeat you, who is in the late stage of foundation building?"
Chen Yuan's voice was very calm, and there was no hint of emotion or anger, but the calmer it was, the more it made Liu Feng's scalp tingle.
"Yes. The disciple used seven points of his strength. He originally wanted to clasp his shoulders with his claws and push him to the ground. However, when his fists and claws collided, his spiritual power directly shook the disciple's hand away."
Liu Feng raised his right hand, and there was still a faint red mark on the tiger's mouth.
"The disciple's jaw is still numb. The spiritual power is not as strong as the sixth level of Qi Refining, and it is not inferior to the middle stage of Foundation Establishment."
Chen Yuan didn't speak, and tapped his fingers on the table twice.
"One more thing."
Liu Feng raised his head.
"Yu Linglong broke through the Nascent Soul a few days ago. But the time of her breakthrough coincided with the time when Lin Chen's cultivation skyrocketed. Before Yu Linglong broke through the Nascent Soul, Lin Chen was still a waste at the third level of Qi Refining. As soon as Yu Linglong broke through, Lin Chen began to skyrocket - from the third level of Qi Refining to the sixth level of Qi Refining, there were only a few days in between."
Chen Yuan slowly stood up, walked to the wall, took out an old sword, and rubbed his fingers back and forth on the sword.
"A waste suddenly turned into a genius, and a Jindan elder who had been trapped for six years broke through the Nascent Soul overnight. The two things collided - it really doesn't seem like a coincidence."
He turned around and looked at Liu Feng.
"When you fought him in the back mountain, did you feel any special aura?"
Liu Feng thought about it carefully.
"The disciple can't explain clearly. His spiritual power is very pure. It's not the kind of illusion that comes from pills. It's real and condensed. And when he punches, there is no fluctuation of spiritual power in his fist, but the force explodes after it hits him. The disciple has never seen this method before."
Chen Yuan hung the old sword back on the wall, sat back in the chair, and was silent for a long time.
The flame of the oil lamp danced several times in the silence.
"Among the ten ancient holy bodies, there is one called the Chaos Holy Body."
He spoke slowly, as if talking to himself.
"It is said that people with this kind of physique can practice much faster than ordinary people, but they need some kind of opportunity to activate. Before activation, they are no different from ordinary people, and after activation, they will make great strides. If it is really the Holy Body of Chaos, ancient books say that the holder and any female cultivator can break through bottlenecks, heal hidden wounds, and increase their cultivation level. Yu Linglong's breakthrough in one night after being trapped for six years is the best proof."
Liu Feng took a breath of cold air.
"Isn't Lin Chen a humanoid treasure?"
"It is rarer than the treasures of heaven, materials and earth. The treasures of heaven, materials and earth can only be used once, while the holy body of chaos can be used repeatedly. Whoever controls him is equivalent to having a breakthrough artifact that can be used infinitely."
There was an imperceptible hint of greed in Chen Yuan's voice.
"Then can't we just capture Lin Chen directly?"
Liu Feng stopped mid-sentence.
"But Yu Linglong is now in the Nascent Soul stage, and she protects Lin Chen very closely. I just heard this morning that she applied to the head master to accept Lin Chen as an official disciple, and also asked him to move into the yard next to Hanyue Pavilion. That place is next to her residence and is protected by prohibitions, so outsiders cannot enter at all."
"Of course, a head-on conflict is not possible. After Yu Linglong broke through Nascent Soul, her status in the sect is no lower than mine. The leader will definitely stand on her side. It is us who will suffer the loss in a head-on confrontation."
"What should we do?"
"Wait. We can't hide the news about the Chaos Holy Body."
The corners of Chen Yuan's mouth curved slightly.
"Lin Chen breaks through so quickly, the foundation building vision will come sooner or later. The whole sect will see it by then, and they can't hide it even if they want. What we have to do is to control him before others can react."
"How to control it?"
"Sect competition."
Chen Yuan stood up and walked to the window.
"This year's competition is about to begin. As usual, the Discipline Hall has the right to review disciples who behave abnormally during the competition. Let Lin Chen participate in the competition and test his background openly and openly on the ring. If he exposes the characteristics of the Chaos Holy Body in the competition, the Discipline Hall can justifiably bring him back."
"What if he didn't stand out so much?"
"impossible."
Chen Yuan turned around with a sinister look in his eyes.
"Once the Holy Body of Chaos awakens, its fighting talent is beyond the comparison of ordinary monks. No matter how hard he hides it, once he gets into the ring, between life and death, that thing cannot be suppressed."
Liu Feng nodded, but still hesitated.
"Uncle Master, if the Chaos Holy Body is really so rare, why has Lin Chen been a waste for the past three years?"
"One possibility is that the Chaos Holy Body requires specific conditions to activate. When Yu Linglong broke through the Nascent Soul, he may have accidentally triggered something in his body. Another possibility is that he has been pretending before. But no matter which possibility, he is now a walking cultivation resource. Whoever gets it first will be a big step ahead of others."
Chen Yuan looked up at Liu Feng.
"You continue to keep an eye on him. Don't do anything in the back mountains, and don't do anything in his yard. Keep an eye on where he goes every day, who he meets, and how long he practices. Also, your cousin Liu Wei, keep him away from Lin Chen. People like Liu Wei are of no use except to frighten snakes."
"Disciple understands."
"Tell him to stay away from him in the future. This matter is related to the future of the Discipline Hall, not your cousin's personal grudge. If Liu Wei goes to trouble Lin Chen again and ruins the overall situation, I won't look down upon you."
Liu Feng's face turned pale and he quickly lowered his head.
title_en: Chapter 4 Secret Report from the Discipline Hall
